messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they give sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They want to compute the standard deviation for the null hypothesis test? Possibly they want the standard error of the mean? Or they want to compute the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard deviation of the sampling distribution under the null hypothesis, which is sigma/sqrt(n). But we don't know population sigma; we have sample sigma 1.4. So maybe they want to compute the standard error: 1.4 / sqrt(40) = 1.4 / 6.3249 = 0.2215. That is the standard error. Then maybe compute t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6) / 0.2215 = -0.4 / 0.2215 = -1.805. Then compute p-value two-tailed: 2 * P(T > |t|) with df=39. That would be something like 0.078? Let's approximate: t=1.805, df=39. Using t-table: For df=40, t=1.684 gives p=0.10, t=2.021 gives p=0.05. So 1.805 is between, so p ~ 0.08. So p-value ~ 0.08. But the user didn't ask for p-value. They asked: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to compute the standard deviation of the null hypothesis test? That is the standard error. So answer: 0.2215. Or maybe they want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution of the mean under null: sigma/sqrt(n). So answer: 1.4 / sqrt(40) ≈ 0.2215. Provide explanation. Also mention t-statistic and p-value. Use the function to compute p-value? The function calculates p-value for t-test. We can call it. Provide p-value. Let's do that.
